ASCII Fold by Maxim Tsenkov (MIT)
https://github.com/mitsenkov/ascii-fold
Vendored from commit cbe3efc1bcb708692a6f647afea72724b2b4f8cb.
Local adaptations: geometry.js assembles independently generated chain geometry in a shared coordinate system; engine.js uses per-chain colors.
Only the renderer and its dependencies are retained.
